about: Clash Royale competency questions derived from KG.MD and corpus/cr.

questions.question: Which cards are included in each deck archetype?
questions.expected: The graph should return deck types, cards, elixir costs, and strategic roles.

questions.question: How many cards are in the game?
questions.expected: The graph should return the number of cards.

questions.question: Which deck types use Miner, and what role does it play?
questions.expected: The graph should return the deck types containing Miner and the role recorded on each relationship.

questions.question: Which gameplay mechanics are described in each source document?
questions.expected: The graph should return source documents, mechanics, sections, and evidence.

questions.question: Which cards occur in more than one deck archetype?
questions.expected: The graph should return cards and the deck archetypes in which they occur.
